gate_legend.G5: Start window by date arithmetic only: "stop" = an explicit employer start window that ends before the supplied availability date. gate_legend.G6: Stack evidence: "pass" = a JVM language in required or responsibility lines plus backend-infrastructure terms. "review" = Java only in preferred/other lines, another language required, or too little text. Evidence locations, not a score.
gate_legend.G7: Sponsorship evidence for this opening: "pass" = apparent offer wording for a person to read (not a guarantee); otherwise "stop" = awaiting opening-level evidence.
gate_legend.G8: Final review: always a person. Nothing is applied to automatically.
